# ClawLink Documentation

Comprehensive guide to using ClawLink - the AI agent integration platform.

## Overview

ClawLink connects OpenClaw, Hermes, and other agent clients to a growing catalog of 150+ external services through one hosted integration layer. Install the client plugin, pair the device in the browser, and connect apps from the dashboard. ClawLink handles hosted auth, encrypted credential storage, retries, and request logging.

## Documentation Site: https://docs.claw-link.dev

### Get Started
- **Introduction** - What ClawLink is and why use it
- **Quick Start** - Install the client, pair your device, and connect your first app
- **OpenClaw setup** - Plugin install, browser pairing, and manual fallback
- **Hermes setup** - Dashboard install flow and browser approval
- **How It Works** - Single-worker runtime architecture and request flow

### Dashboard
- **Overview** - Navigate and understand your dashboard
- **Integrations** - Add, reconnect, and remove connection rows
- **Request Logs** - Monitor every tool call your agent makes
- **Settings** - Profile, advanced API keys, and account security handoff

### Integration Categories

#### Communication
- Gmail - Send/read emails, create drafts, manage labels
- Slack - Send messages, manage channels, webhooks
- Discord - Bot messages, server management
- Microsoft Teams - Channel messaging, team management
- Telegram - Bot API, send messages

#### Productivity
- Notion - Pages, databases, blocks (read/write)
- Google Docs - Create and update documents
- Google Sheets - Read/write data, formulas
- Calendar - Events, scheduling

#### Developer Tools
- GitHub - Repositories, issues, pull requests, branches
- GitLab - Projects, merge requests
- Jira - Issues, projects, workflows

#### Payments
- Stripe - Customers, payments, invoices, subscriptions

#### CRM & Sales
- HubSpot - Contacts, companies, deals, tickets
- Salesforce - Objects, SOQL queries

#### Social Media
- Twitter/X - Tweets, user info
- LinkedIn - Posts, profile

## Security Features

- Credentials encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM)
- Decrypted only at moment of API call
- Never stored in plaintext
- Browser pairing keeps provider credentials off the client
- API key rotation in dashboard

## Troubleshooting

Common issues and solutions:
- Pairing issues
- Hosted connection problems (needs reconnect)
- Rate limiting
- Permission errors / expired OAuth tokens
- Timeout issues

## Billing

- New accounts start with a 7-day free trial — the first app is included, no credit card required
- Starter plan: $4.99 your first month, then $7.99/month — every integration unlocked, 1,000 tool calls/month
- Ultra Heavy plan: $19.99/month — unlimited tool calls
- After the trial, an active paid plan is required to keep integrations active
- Fair-use tool calls: 1,000 per period on trial and Starter (Starter resets monthly); unlimited on Ultra Heavy
- Manage billing from Dashboard > Billing; payments handled by Polar
